title: Therapy Visit Copay by Discipline
content:
## Therapy discipline copay schedule — Medicaid Managed Care Membership

The re-rated copay of a visit in a rehabilitation therapy course follows the therapy discipline recorded on the member's rehabilitation therapy authorization in the Prior Authorization records.

| Therapy discipline on the authorization | Re-rated copay per course visit |
|---|---|
| Physical therapy | 2.00 USD (the rehabilitation visit copay) |
| Occupational therapy | 2.00 USD (the rehabilitation visit copay) |
| Speech therapy | 1.00 USD (the speech visit copay) |
| Any other discipline | The category's outpatient hospital copay |

**Clause.** Physical therapy and occupational therapy re-rate at the rehabilitation visit copay of 2.00 USD, speech therapy re-rates at the speech visit copay of 1.00 USD, and any other discipline keeps the category's outpatient hospital copay. The discipline read is the one on the rehabilitation therapy authorization of the course, approved on a request received in the therapy window, whether still approved or since expired.

## Notes to the schedule

- The rate is chosen by the discipline alone; the billing provider's type and the number of visits do not change it.
- Physical and occupational therapy share one rate.
- Where no such authorization is on file, no discipline is read, and the course visit keeps the category's outpatient hospital copay.

**Illustration (hypothetical).** A course authorized for speech therapy holds four visits: each re-rates at 1.00 USD, 4.00 USD for the four. The same four visits under an occupational therapy authorization re-rate at 2.00 USD each, 8.00 USD in all.
